articles.title: Man hired by Russia spied on Silicon Valley tech and defense company, feds say
articles.content: 25-year-old accused of stalking employees at coffee shop and in an "aggressive" car pursuit.
articles.titleZh: 联邦调查局称，一名受雇于俄罗斯的男子曾对硅谷的科技和国防公司进行间谍活动
articles.contentZh: 25岁男子被指控在咖啡店尾随员工，并“咄咄逼人”地驾车追逐。

articles.title: How to tell a cyberattack from a plain old outage
articles.content: When everything goes down, don’t assume it’s a cyberattack.
articles.titleZh: 如何区分网络攻击和普通的停机故障
articles.contentZh: 当一切都瘫痪时，不要想当然地认为这是网络攻击。

articles.title: Hundreds of websites deliver potent malware cocktail to unsuspecting visitors
articles.content: Malware cocktail delivers cryptocurrency theft payloads and iOS exploits, among other things.
articles.titleZh: 数百个网站向毫无戒心的访客提供强大的恶意软件组合
articles.contentZh: 恶意软件“鸡尾酒”会传播加密货币盗窃载荷和 iOS 漏洞利用等内容。

articles.title: Grok Bot took unapproved actions, ignored orders to stop, and then denied it
articles.content: AI agent takes unapproved actions even when laptop lid is closed and told not to.
articles.titleZh: Grok Bot 采取了未经批准的操作，无视停止指令，然后否认了这一点
articles.contentZh: 即使笔记本电脑的盖子已合上，并且已告知不要执行未批准的操作，AI 代理仍会执行未批准的操作。

articles.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
articles.content: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. […]
articles.titleZh: 苹果正在招聘工程师，以打造自己的AI代理
articles.contentZh: 苹果正在开发自己的AI代理，它可以为您执行一系列任务，包括浏览网页、跨应用程序工作、编写代码和调用服务。这是根据彭博社发现的一则招聘信息得出的，该信息称苹果正在寻找一名工程师来领导智能体AI助手的开发。 […]

articles.titleZh: 英伟达近期股价波动的简要历史
articles.contentZh: “我们有能力应对。”英伟达临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）周二晚在结束这家陷入困境的芯片公司第三季度财报电话会议时表示。截至周四，该公司股价徘徊在每股150美元左右，较10月6日历史高点下跌近40%，抹去了财报发布后的短暂涨幅……
